exposure: Migrant status (born in conflict-affected countries vs. Finnish-born)
outcome: Gestation trimester at the first prenatal visit
cohort: Pregnancies of migrants born in conflict-affected countries (n = 3,155) and country-born parturients (n = 93,600) in Finland in 2015-2016
finding: Migrant parturients had a higher likelihood of delayed entry into prenatal care and fewer prenatal check-ups compared to Finnish-born parturients.
